name: Burger King
disclaimer_extra: Burger King publishes each menu item as sold and each topping as its own figure. The build-your-own portions are the ones Burger King lists for the Whopper: a slice of cheese on a Whopper is not the same slice as on a Jr., so pooling them would invent a portion the chain does not serve.
blurb: Burger King is one of the few chains that publishes a figure for every topping as well as every sandwich, which is why you can take the mayo off a Whopper here and watch 158 calories leave with it. Start from a menu item for the sandwich as it is sold, or build one from the bun up.
